equation: dX(t) = (a + b * X(t)) * dt + c * dW(t)
diffusion_derivative: dg/dX = 0  (g(X) = c is constant, additive noise)
milstein_correction: 0  (additive noise: Milstein correction vanishes, Milstein == Euler-Maruyama)
implementation_notes: Linear SDE with additive noise: drift f(X) = a + b*X (linear in X), diffusion g = c constant. Additive noise so Milstein reduces to Euler-Maruyama; use EM. With b=-1 the process is mean-reverting toward a/b=2 and the analytic variance c^2/(2b)*(exp(2bt)-1) = 0.125*(1-exp(-2t)) > 0. At T=1: mean = exp(-1)*(0 - 2) + 2 = 2*(1-exp(-1)) approx 1.264, variance = 0.125*(1-exp(-2)) approx 0.1081. Mean is well above near-zero threshold, so mean check applies.
